ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 70% high-intensity white interior pixels and 30% low-intensity black/dark-grey peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the interior of both lobes; a consistent dark perimeter band (roughly 10-20 pixels wide) follows the trailing edge; dense black mottling and irregular stippling is concentrated at the median notch vertex and extends into the mid-lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-measured vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees and a depth approximately 1/6th of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; peaks and valleys range from 3 to 12 pixels in amplitude, creating a jagged boundary against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in blunt, heavily textured endpoints.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, multi-colored (tan/white/grey) clusters of roughly circular high-contrast pixels located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the lower section of the left lobe, cutting through the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization and resulting physical textural deformation on both lateral tips; minor notches in the trailing edge topography that deviate from standard serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, isolated dark 'teardrop' pigmentation spot is located on the right lobe, approximately 15 pixels distal and 10 pixels inferior to the median notch vertex.
